must.name: Kaynes Technology
must.headline: Approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
must.subject: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreements
must.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a Joint Venture Agreement with Toyokawa Techno Private Limited to manufacture Thin-Film Transistor Display Modules. The Board also proposed the voluntary strike-off of subsidiary Kaynes Embedded Systems Private Limited, subject to statutory formalities. The auditor's review noted restatements for prior period errors. The consolidated results include a share of net loss from associate Mixx Technologies, Inc. of Rs. 60.02 million for the quarter and Rs. 104.40 million for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026. The auditor could not comment on adjustments related to the associate due to lack of reviewed financials. The meeting concluded at 21:30 IST on November 14, 2026.

enrich.takeaway: Revenue +41% YoY; PAT -25% YoY; margin compressed 1.2pp; profit lagging sales.

The company filed this disclosure with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. must.headline: Executed a binding term sheet on November 12, 2026, with Vishay Intertechnology Inc., its subsidiary Ecomal Nederland B.V., and its wholly owned subsi…
must.subject: Kaynes Technology India Limited (Company) has informed the Exchange about execution of binding term sheet amongst the Company, Kaynes Semicon Private Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. and Ecomal Nederland B.V.
must.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited executed a binding term sheet on November 12, 2026, with Vishay Intertechnology Inc., its subsidiary Ecomal Nederland B.V., and its wholly owned subsidiary Kaynes Semicon Private Limited. The agreement establishes a joint venture through Kaynes Semicon Private Limited to provide semiconductor back-end manufacturing services, including post-fab wafer processing, assembly, test, and packaging. Vishay will acquire a 49% stake in the subsidiary. Mr. Raghu Panicker will serve as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the subsidiary. The transaction is subject to finalization of terms, execution of definitive agreements, required approvals, and customary closing conditions.

look.summary: HDFC Bank Limited has approved the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director for a period of one year effective from November 23, 2026. This approval follows recommendations from the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and consent from the Reserve Bank of India. The re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Rangan will continue at extant remuneration. He is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank and is not debarred from holding office. The bank will seek shareholder approval for this re-appointment.

look.subject: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Q2FY27 Results.
look.summary: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. Chennai Metro Rail Limited redesigned a critical stretch between Alandur and St Thomas Mount to avoid acquiring defence land. The revised alignment involves constructing Phase 2 of Corridor 5 beneath the existing Chennai Central to St Thomas Mount corridor. This change is expected to save six months of construction time. The additional engineering work involves a supplementary tender worth around 300 crore. Chennai Metro Rail Limited plans a 45-day suspension of train services tentatively in February or March 2027, subject to approval from the Commissioner of Railway Safety. The target for completing the entire elevated stretch towards Sholinganallur is September 2027.

routine.name: Trent
routine.headline: Issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them.
routine.subject: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
routine.summary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.

routine.name: ITC
routine.headline: Allotted 7,85,300 ordinary shares of one rupee each on 13th November 2026.
routine.subject: ITC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 785300  Shares.
routine.summary: ITC Limited allotted 7,85,300 ordinary shares of one rupee each on 13th November 2026. This allotment resulted from the exercise of 78,530 options by optionees under the company's Employee Stock Option Schemes. The committee meeting for the allotment concluded at 3:10 p.m. Consequently, the issued and subscribed share capital of ITC Limited increased to 1253,26,97,881 rupees. This capital is divided into 1253,26,97,881 ordinary shares of one rupee each. The change is effective from 13th November 2026.
